message.content:
{
  "operations": [
    {
      "op": "update",
      "collection": "processes",
      "target_id": "PROC_PRIMER_FORMATION",
      "fields": {
        "precondition_state_refs": ["ST_DNA_TEMPLATE_AVAILABLE"],
        "effect_state_refs": ["ST_PRIMER_PRESENT"]
      }
    },
    {
      "op": "update",
      "collection": "processes",
      "target_id": "PROC_POL_ALPHA_EXTENSION",
      "fields": {
        "precondition_state_refs": ["ST_PRIMER_PRESENT"],
        "effect_state_refs": ["ST_SHORT_DNA_ADDED", "ST_HANDOFF_READY"]
      }
    },
    {
      "op": "update",
      "collection": "processes",
      "target_id": "PROC_POL_DELTA_EXTENSION",
      "fields": {
        "precondition_state_refs": ["ST_HANDOFF_READY"],
        "effect_state_refs": ["ST_OKAZAKI_FRAGMENT_SYNTHESIZED", "ST_PRIMER_DISPLACED"]
      }
    },
    {
      "op": "update",
      "collection": "processes",
      "target_id": "PROC_PRIMER_REMOVAL",
      "fields": {
        "precondition_state_refs": ["ST_PRIMER_DISPLACED"],
        "effect_state_refs": ["ST_PRIMER_REMOVED", "ST_REPLACEMENT_GAP_EXTERNAL"],
        "terminates_state_refs": ["ST_PRIMER_DISPLACED"]
      }
    },
    {
      "op": "update",
      "collection": "processes",
      "target_id": "PROC_LIGATION",
      "fields": {
        "precondition_state_refs": ["ST_REPLACEMENT_GAP_EXTERNAL"],
        "effect_state_refs": ["ST_GAPS_SEALED", "ST_OKAZAKI_FRAGMENTS_JOINED"]
      }
    }
  ],
  "state_upgrade": {
    "schema_version": "1.1",
    "clip_start": {
      "stage": "local lagging-strand region after origin unwinding; DNA template accessible and primase recruited",
      "existing_entity_refs": ["ENT_DNA_TEMPLATE", "ENT_PRIMASE", "ENT_RNA_PRIMER", "ENT_POL_ALPHA", "ENT_POL_DELTA", "ENT_RNASE_H", "ENT_DNA_LIGASE", "ENT_LAGGING_DNA_PRODUCT", "ENT_GAP_SUBSTRATE"],
      "omitted_processes": [
        {"description": "Origin recognition and pre-replication complex assembly", "reason": "Task states origins already covered; excluded by scope.", "required_by_task": false},
        {"description": "Helicase unwinding and topoisomerase supercoiling relief", "reason": "Excluded by scope; template accessibility treated as initial condition supported by source general statement.", "required_by_task": false},
        {"description": "Leading-strand continuous synthesis by DNA polymerase epsilon", "reason": "Excluded by scope; local lagging-strand region only.", "required_by_task": false},
        {"description": "Telomerase-mediated telomere elongation", "reason": "Excluded by scope; not local replication maturation event requested.", "required_by_task": false},
        {"description": "Nucleosome/histone removal and replacement", "reason": "Excluded by scope; not required for local priming/extension/maturation explanation.", "required_by_task": false},
        {"description": "Proofreading and mismatch repair", "reason": "Excluded by scope; not required for described local events.", "required_by_task": false}
      ]
    },
    "states": [
      {
        "state_id": "ST_DNA_TEMPLATE_AVAILABLE",
        "subject_ref": "ENT_DNA_TEMPLATE",
        "property": "template_availability",
        "value": "accessible",
        "state_kind": "INITIAL_CONDITION",
        "scope": {"region": "local lagging-strand region", "clip": "before primer formation"},
        "producer_process_id": null,
        "required_by_process_ids": ["PROC_PRIMER_FORMATION"],
        "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"],
        "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_d8ffea5a5785", "quote": "Before replication can start, the DNA has to be made available as a template.", "location": "paragraph_3"}]
      },
      {
        "state_id": "ST_PRIMER_PRESENT",
        "subject_ref": "ENT_RNA_PRIMER",
        "property": "presence",
        "value": "formed",
        "state_kind": "PRODUCED_STATE",
        "scope": {"region": "local lagging-strand region", "clip": "after primase action"},
        "producer_process_id": "PROC_PRIMER_FORMATION",
        "required_by_process_ids": ["PROC_POL_ALPHA_EXTENSION"],
        "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"],
        "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_d8ffea5a5785", "quote": "Primers are formed by the enzyme primase, and using the primer, DNA pol can start synthesis.", "location": "paragraph_4"}]
      },
      {
        "state_id": "ST_SHORT_DNA_ADDED",
        "subject_ref": "ENT_RNA_PRIMER",
        "property": "extension",
        "value": "short_dna_fragment_added",
        "state_kind": "PRODUCED_STATE",
        "scope": {"region": "local lagging-strand region", "clip": "after pol alpha extension"},
        "producer_process_id": "PROC_POL_ALPHA_EXTENSION",
        "required_by_process_ids": [],
        "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"],
        "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_d8ffea5a5785", "quote": "DNA pol α adds a short (20 to 30 nucleotides) DNA fragment to the RNA primer on both strands", "location": "paragraph_4"}]
      },
      {
        "state_id": "ST_HANDOFF_READY",
        "subject_ref": "ENT_POL_ALPHA",
        "property": "handoff_status",
        "value": "ready_for_second_polymerase",
        "state_kind": "PRODUCED_STATE",
        "scope": {"region": "local lagging-strand region", "clip": "after pol alpha extension"},
        "producer_process_id": "PROC_POL_ALPHA_EXTENSION",
        "required_by_process_ids": ["PROC_POL_DELTA_EXTENSION"],
        "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"],
        "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_d8ffea5a5785", "quote": "and then hands off to a second polymerase", "location": "paragraph_4"}]
      },
      {
        "state_id": "ST_OKAZAKI_FRAGMENT_SYNTHESIZED",
        "subject_ref": "ENT_LAGGING_DNA_PRODUCT",
        "property": "synthesis_status",
        "value": "short_stretch_synthesized",
        "state_kind": "PRODUCED_STATE",
        "scope": {"region": "local lagging-strand region", "clip": "during pol delta extension"},
        "producer_process_id": "PROC_POL_DELTA_EXTENSION",
        "required_by_process_ids": [],
        "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"],
        "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_d8ffea5a5785", "quote": "the lagging strand is synthesized by pol δ .", "location": "paragraph_4"}],
        "uncertainty": "Process identity of pol delta on lagging strand is supported broadly; handoff from pol alpha to pol delta is schematic inference (ISS_002)."
      },
      {
        "state_id": "ST_PRIMER_DISPLACED",
        "subject_ref": "ENT_RNA_PRIMER",
        "property": "template_attachment",
        "value": "displaced_from_template",
        "state_kind": "PRODUCED_STATE",
        "scope": {"region": "local lagging-strand region", "clip": "when pol delta reaches primer"},
        "producer_process_id": "PROC_POL_DELTA_EXTENSION",
        "required_by_process_ids": ["PROC_PRIMER_REMOVAL"],
        "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"],
        "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_d8ffea5a5785", "quote": "As pol δ runs into the primer RNA on the lagging strand, it displaces it from the DNA template.", "location": "paragraph_4"}]
      },
      {
        "state_id": "ST_PRIMER_REMOVED",
        "subject_ref": "ENT_RNA_PRIMER",
        "property": "presence",
        "value": "removed",
        "state_kind": "PRODUCED_STATE",
        "scope": {"region": "local lagging-strand region", "clip": "after RNase H action"},
        "producer_process_id": "PROC_PRIMER_REMOVAL",
        "required_by_process_ids": [],
        "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"],
        "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_d8ffea5a5785", "quote": "The displaced primer RNA is then removed by RNase H (AKA flap endonuclease )", "location": "paragraph_4"}],
        "uncertainty": "Source equates RNase H and flap endonuclease parenthetically; no distinct activity identity is asserted (ISS_001)."
      },
      {
        "state_id": "ST_REPLACEMENT_GAP_EXTERNAL",
        "subject_ref": "ENT_GAP_SUBSTRATE",
        "property": "replacement_status",
        "value": "assumed_dna_replacement_completed_external",
        "state_kind": "REQUIRED_PRECONDITION",
        "scope": {"region": "local lagging-strand region", "clip": "between primer removal and ligation"},
        "producer_process_id": null,
        "required_by_process_ids": ["PROC_LIGATION"],
        "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"],
        "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_d8ffea5a5785", "quote": "and replaced with DNA nucleotides", "location": "paragraph_4"}],
        "assumption_note": "Replacement synthesis is excluded from model scope; state represents an externally supplied precondition, not a modeled process product. This preserves ligation precondition reachability without asserting a specific polymerase (ISS_003, ISS_005)."
      },
      {
        "state_id": "ST_GAPS_SEALED",
        "subject_ref": "ENT_GAP_SUBSTRATE",
        "property": "seal_status",
        "value": "sealed",
        "state_kind": "PRODUCED_STATE",
        "scope": {"region": "local lagging-strand region", "clip": "after ligation"},
        "producer_process_id": "PROC_LIGATION",
        "required_by_process_ids": [],
        "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"],
        "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_d8ffea5a5785", "quote": "The gaps that remain are sealed by DNA ligase, which forms the phosphodiester bond.", "location": "paragraph_4"}]
      },
      {
        "state_id": "ST_OKAZAKI_FRAGMENTS_JOINED",
        "subject_ref": "ENT_LAGGING_DNA_PRODUCT",
        "property": "fragment_joining",
        "value": "joined",
        "state_kind": "PRODUCED_STATE",
        "scope": {"region": "local lagging-strand region", "clip": "after ligation"},
        "producer_process_id": "PROC_LIGATION",
        "required_by_process_ids": [],
        "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"],
        "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_d8ffea5a5785", "quote": "The Okazaki fragments in the lagging strand are joined after the replacement of the RNA primers with DNA.", "location": "paragraph_4"}]
      }
    ]
  },
  "issue_resolution": [
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_001",
      "changed_target_ids": ["PROC_PRIMER_REMOVAL", "ENT_RNASE_H"],
      "reason": "Source explicitly parenthesizes 'RNase H (AKA flap endonuclease)'; no distinction is supported. Model retains unresolved identity and does not assert equivalence beyond source wording; state added documents the uncertainty. No new evidence found to separate activities.",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_002",
      "changed_target_ids": ["PROC_POL_DELTA_EXTENSION", "PROC_POL_ALPHA_EXTENSION"],
      "reason": "Source says pol alpha 'hands off to a second polymerase' without naming pol delta as lagging-strand recipient. Typed state ST_HANDOFF_READY is modeled as generic handoff; pol delta assignment to lagging strand is supported separately by 'the lagging strand is synthesized by pol δ', but the specific alpha→delta handoff remains schematic inference flagged in state uncertainty.",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_003",
      "changed_target_ids": ["PROC_LIGATION", "ST_REPLACEMENT_GAP_EXTERNAL"],
      "reason": "Replacement synthesis is excluded by scope, so a modeled replacement process would exceed task scope. Instead, precondition is represented as an externally supplied REQUIRED_PRECONDITION state marked as assumed external; this keeps typed state reachable without silently seeding or asserting an unsupported polymerase identity.",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_004",
      "changed_target_ids": ["PROC_POL_DELTA_EXTENSION", "PROC_PRIMER_REMOVAL"],
      "reason": "Added explicit state ST_PRIMER_DISPLACED produced by pol delta extension and required by primer removal; primer removal terminates this state. This makes the displacement-to-removal-competence transition explicit rather than implicit via participant listing.",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_005",
      "changed_target_ids": ["PROC_LIGATION", "ST_REPLACEMENT_GAP_EXTERNAL", "ST_GAPS_SEALED"],
      "reason": "The source's 'gaps that remain' are treated as a simplified nucleic-acid-region placeholder; the model does not claim a distinct nicked phosphodiester-backbone state. ST_REPLACEMENT_GAP_EXTERNAL acknowledges simplification and external replacement assumption; ST_GAPS_SEALED records the source-supported sealed outcome.",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "STATE_MODEL_MIGRATION",
      "changed_target_ids": ["PROC_PRIMER_FORMATION", "PROC_POL_ALPHA_EXTENSION", "PROC_POL_DELTA_EXTENSION", "PROC_PRIMER_REMOVAL", "PROC_LIGATION"],
      "reason": "Added typed precondition/effect state refs across all five processes and a states collection. Only state slots required by included mechanisms were created; no required mechanism omitted and no excluded process silently modeled as included. Initial condition is only the source-supported template-availability state.",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_d8ffea5a5785"]
    }
  ]
}
